source: FTA Public Clarification CTP010 (April 2026) · CT Law Article 36
headline: A JOB TITLE DOESN'T
DECIDE WHO IS

blocks.text: Only board members count as connected persons.

items: **Officers count:** anyone who makes strategic decisions or can sign deals that bind the company
**Owners, directors** and their related parties count
**Pay and benefits** to them are deductible only up to **market value**
